name: Dominated By: Sadistic Childhood Valentine
source:
After moving away from your hometown, your sadistic childhood friend who's tormented you for the majority of your life tracks you down and mercilessly torments you on Valentine's Day.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3546130/Dominated_By_Sadistic_Childhood_Valentine/?curator_clanid=45331749] Steam[/url]]
translation:
搬离故乡之后，那个从小到大折磨了你大半辈子的嗜虐青梅竹马竟一路追查到了你的下落，并在情人节这天对你展开了变本加厉的无情欺凌。
